mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (answer_id, user_id, content) VALUES (#{answerId}, #{userId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id, c.answer_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.deleted_at, u.nickname FROM comment c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.answer_id = #{answerId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at ASC

SELECT c.comment_id, c.answer_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.deleted_at, u.nickname FROM comment c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.comment_id = #{commentId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
